ability.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
ability.description: Gains no new weapon or armor proficiencies.

ability.name: Enhance Arrow
ability.description: Non-magical arrows gain an enhancement bonus equal to class level (max +5) when fired.

ability.name: Imbue Arrow
ability.description: Can place an area spell on an arrow, with the spell detonating on impact at the target point.

ability.name: Seeker Arrow
ability.description: Once per day, fire an arrow that veers toward the target, ignoring miss chances and cover (except total).

ability.name: Phase Arrow
ability.description: Once per day, fire an arrow that passes through objects and cover (except total) to strike a visible target.

ability.name: Hail of Arrows
ability.description: Once per day, fire one arrow at each enemy within range (one per arrow possessed), each using full attack bonus.

ability.name: Arrow of Death
ability.description: Once per day, create a special arrow that forces a Fort save (DC 20) or die upon hit.
